headline: S&T Legal advises Fusion CX on acquisition of impacx

detail: Fusion CX Limited has acquired the entire share capital of impacx solutions GmbH, tel-inform solutions GmbH and impacx services GmbH (together, “impacx”), a customer experience company headquartered in Kleve, Germany. S&T Legal advised Fusion CX on this acquisition. The Firm’s mandate included legal due diligence on the German entities, transaction structuring, and the drafting and negotiation of the Share Purchase and Transfer Agreement and ancillary documents. The Firm is also advising on the conditions precedent and closing process, in coordination with Fusion CX’s in-house team and the German legal team.
